name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
desc: Ghost-lights hover and wander low over a marsh — soft glowing orbs with bright cores and wide halos, winking out and drifting elsewhere, mirrored in the water below over a luminous ground-mist band; sits over any dark landscape or water scene.

style.doc: foxfire=green-cyan / lantern=warm amber / spectral=violet-white / marsh_gas=sickly yellow-green
